learning_outcomes.text: Experience team working in implementing group time planning and individual task scheduling.
Develop a concept from inception to detailed design using a formalised engineering design process.
Develop decision making strategies using mechanical and/or aerodynamic engineering principles.
Appreciate design as a process of iteration and optimisation.

syllabus_topics: Design of a remote-controlled UAV to carry maximum payload to mass ratio
Design of a remote-controlled UAV to carry the most golf balls on one battery charge
Design of a small rooftop wind turbine for electrical power generation
Design of a small robotic arm for lifting and placement tasks
Design of a small hydro-kinetic energy generator for electrical power generation
assessment_rules: Students must gain a summative mark of 40% to pass the module. For students who have not passed the module by the Exam Board, re-assessment consists of submission of alternate coursework prior to commencement of the July/August exam diet. For students registered as Academic Assessment Only, re-assessment consists of submission of alternate coursework prior to commencement of the December exam diet. No marks from any previous attempts will be transferred to a new resit attempt.
